description: Read full records by ID within the selected Vault. Requires read permission. Returns id, vault_id, content, created_at, updated_at, status, revision, created_by and updated_by (account IDs). Use the returned revision as expected_revision for an update, and read again after a revision_conflict. A missing or out-of-scope record is not available through this key.

ids.description: Record IDs from recall or list in the selected Vault.
